facility.name: Tarkington Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2520 FM 163 RD, CLEVELAND, TX, 77327

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: The operation policy was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation has not had a health inspection since 8/28/2024
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: CCR observed two fire extinguishers accessible to children on the floor in the school-age classroom.     Correction made: The caregiver stored the fire extinguisher, and it was inaccessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Attendance records for the director/owner were not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - on Sides: CCR observed two stationary equipment: a play equipment with a slide and a rocking equipment seat, not located within 6 feet away from the to-fro swing structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §746.4807(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: CCR observed cleaning supplies stored under an unlocked sink cabinet in both the toddler and school-age classrooms. Additionally, cleaning wipes, diaper ointments, a toy, baby wipes, and specks of dirt were noted on the diaper changing table in the toddler classroom.    Correction made: The caregiver removed the cleaning supplies and ointments and cleaned the diaper table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation has not had a fire inspection since 8/28/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: The infant caregiver is not completing daily reports for infants to share with parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: One caregivers file reviewed did not contain their CPR/First aid training or their SIDS/Shaking Baby Syndrome training record or certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregivers file reviewed did not have the required signed affidavit. There was a blank affidavit in the caregivers file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: There was an infant in a high chair that was not strapped in with the straps that were attached to the high chair.    A caregiver corrected this at the time of the inspection by strapping the child in the chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: There was heater/fan that was on a shelf that was accessible to children.    The person in charge corrected this at the time of the inspection by removing the heater/fan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: There was a person in the operation counted in child caregiver ratio who did not have a background check.    The person in charge corrected this at the time of the inspection by having the person leave the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the information gathered during the investigation inspection, the Director allowed a person with no background check to supervise children alone, turned off the water during a freeze which resulted in proper handwashing techniques not being used for employees and children, a pipe busting causing a leak, and not reporting to Licensing when a child received medical attention when a shelf fell on the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Based on the information gathered when the water was turned off children's hands were not being properly washed. Baby wipes and hand sanitizer were being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection it was found that a ceiling tile was missing and above the tile was a pipe that was leaking water.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: It was found during the investigation that the operation did not report to Licensing that a child received medical treatment when a shelf fell on the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing Before Eating or Handling Food: Based on the information gathered when the water was turned off employee's hands were not being properly washed. Baby wipes and hand sanitizer were being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing Before Eating or Handling Food (26 TAC §746.3415(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Based on the information gathered when the water was turned off children's hands were not being properly washed. Baby wipes and hand sanitizer were being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting: Based on the information gathered when the water was turned off employee's hands were not being properly washed. Baby wipes and hand sanitizer were being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting (26 TAC §746.3415(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The Fire Inspection expired on 3/15/2024.    The Director is going to correct this by getting the Fire Inspection done.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The Sanitation Inspection expired on 3/15/2024.    The Director is going to correct this by getting the Sanitation Inspection done.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The Director and the employee who transport children both had expired transportation training.    The Director and the employee are getting the training done today before they transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: There was a diaper changing mat that had a tear in it.    The Director corrected this at the time of the inspection by replacing the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: The nap cots in two classrooms were placed too close together which caused there to not be sufficient walking space around the cots.    This was corrected that the time of the inspection by the caregivers rearranging the nap cots to provide sufficient walking space around each cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There were five trash cans without lids that made trash accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease: Not all parents were notified that a person in the center tested positive for COVID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.307(d))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Caregivers and staff admitted that they give children candy as a reward for toilet training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: The Director did not notify the health department or licensing that a person tested positive for COVID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was a person in the operation who did not have a cleared background check. The person left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
